package.description: A modern, highly configurable leader-key driven command overlay for Windows.

en-US.description: A modern, highly configurable leader-key driven command overlay for Windows.
en-US.longDescription:
Glyph is a Windows-first, highly configurable leader-key overlay.
Press the Glyph key to open an overlay, then type short sequences to trigger actions.

Keymaps are configured in YAML with optional per-app layers.
Themes are JSON-based.
en-US.name: Glyph
